primary.reason: Blacksmiths make the Lionheart Helm, a pre-raid helm for damage warriors, and can make their own weapons and armour.
Engineering gives grenades, sappers and target dummies, the strongest tools for tanking and PvP.
Devilsaur leather and the Devilsaur set, plus steady gold from leather sales while leveling.

secondary.reason: Bandages cut downtime for every class and are needed for elites without a healer.
Well Fed buffs add stats, and in WoW Forever cooked food also gives a small kill-experience bonus and powers camp features.
Optional; useful for cooking skill and for Mightfish and Stonescale Eel if you sell to raiders.

levelingPlan.note: Mining reaches 300 naturally by gathering in Un'Goro, Felwood, Winterspring and the Plaguelands along this route.
Level Blacksmithing with the materials saved from the route; buy the last recipes in the capitals or from the vendors linked in the step hooks.
Follow the cooking hooks: Roast Raptor and Giant Clam Scorcho in Stranglethorn, Tender Wolf Steak from Tanaris, Monster Omelet from Felwood.
Buy Expert First Aid in Dustwallow Marsh and do the Triage quest at Hammerfall once you reach 225 skill.

any.text: Keep a two-hander for questing and swap to sword and board only for elites and dungeons. Sweeping Strikes or Cleave on two mobs is faster than one-at-a-time pulls.
Bandage between pulls; First Aid is your cheapest downtime fix until you have a healer.

tank.text: In dungeons, mark one kill target and one sheep or trap target per pack; Sunder the skull and tab-Sunder the second mob.

any.text: WoW Forever lets Undead play Paladin. Quest with Seal of Command or Seal of Righteousness and a slow two-hander; judge only when you will reseal before the next swing.

sources.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever, what's new (class changes)

any.text: Pull two mobs, use Consecration only when three or more are on you, and drink while Blessing of Wisdom ticks. Undead Paladins can use Cannibalize on humanoid and undead corpses instead of eating.

sources.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever, what's new (class changes)

tank.text: Tank with Righteous Fury and a shield; Consecration holds packs but costs mana, so let the healer know before big pulls.

healer.text: Holy Light rank downranking keeps mana up; save Lay on Hands for a wipe-saving moment on the tank.

any.text: Feign Death drops threat from extra mobs; use it to reset bad pulls instead of running. Keep the pet a level-appropriate beast so it holds aggro.
WoW Forever lets hunters use traps in combat and gives pets gear scaling and family abilities; check your pet family's ability before you choose a new one.

sources.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever, what's new (class changes)

any.text: Stealth past mobs that are not quest targets and open with Cheap Shot on casters. Use Sprint and Vanish to skip long runs back to a quest area.
Pick Lockpicking up as you go: the lockboxes from this bracket open junk boxes you can sell and the skill opens doors in Blackrock Depths.
Shadow is the fast way to level: Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Pain, wand. Power Word: Shield before the mob arrives so you take no pushback.

healer.text: In dungeons use lower ranks of Heal and Greater Heal; Renew on the tank before big pulls saves mana.

any.text: WoW Forever adds Horde-aligned Skyborne (Windshapers) as Shaman. Their racials differ from Orc, Troll and Tauren, so check them before you pick totems and talents.

sources.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever, what's new (class changes)

any.text: Enhancement with Windfury and a slow two-hander levels fastest. Drop only the totems you need for the fight; Searing Totem on single mobs is wasted mana.

healer.text: Chain Heal at rank 1 or 2 is your most efficient group heal; keep Mana Spring Totem down in long fights.

any.text: Frost: Frost Nova, step back, Frostbolt. Arcane Explosion AoE pulls with a Frost Nova reset are the fastest way through mob camps. WoW Forever opens Orc Mage for the Horde.

sources.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever, what's new (class changes)

any.text: Conjure food and water before each zone so you never pay for drinks.
Affliction with the Voidwalker: dot two mobs, Drain Life, Life Tap and keep moving. WoW Forever opens Troll Warlock for the Horde.

sources.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever, what's new (class changes)

any.text: Farm Soul Shards on the last mob of a pull, not the first, so you are not waiting on Drain Soul.
Quest in Cat Form; shift to Bear for two or more mobs. Travel Form between quest areas until your mount, and use it to skip fights you do not need.

tank.text: Bear tanks hold packs with Swipe; ask for a mark on the kill target.

healer.text: Regrowth and Rejuvenation on the tank, Healing Touch only for big hits; Innervate yourself during long boss fights.

tips.text: The Bulwark's cauldron chain moves you through the fields in a fixed order; follow it and kill everything on the path.
Most mobs here are undead. Paladins: Exorcism and Holy Wrath hit them hard and Seal of Command procs often. Undead Paladins can Cannibalize on the corpses.
Priests can Shackle Undead the extra mob in a pull; Shadow Word: Pain still works on undead.
Abandon quests you are not about to turn in before you fly from Kalimdor to the Plaguelands. The quest log holds 40.
